name: plugin.openclaw_a2a
description: A2A v1.0 Agent-to-Agent protocol adapter for cross-host swarm federation, task delegation, and distributed observation streaming.

entrypoints.name: openclaw_a2a_send_task
entrypoints.description: Dispatches an asynchronous subtask to a federated remote or local A2A agent runtime.

parameters.name: recipient_agent
parameters.description: Identifier or URL of recipient agent (e.g. 'openclaw_worker_01', 'agent_debater')

parameters.name: task_payload
parameters.description: Structured task payload with objective, parameters, and input context

entrypoints.name: openclaw_a2a_poll_task
entrypoints.description: Polls the status, observation, and token telemetry of an active A2A task.

entrypoints.name: openclaw_a2a_complete_task
entrypoints.description: Completes an A2A task and records observation output and token rollups.

parameters.name: task_id
parameters.description: Task identifier to mark as completed

parameters.name: tokens_used
parameters.description: Number of tokens consumed during task execution

entrypoints.name: openclaw_a2a_resolve_capabilities
entrypoints.description: Queries supported capabilities, tools, and archetype roles for a registered A2A agent.
